analogy.rationale: S1PR1 is a Gi-coupled lysophospholipid receptor whose expression is largely restricted to vascular and immune cells, so most of these cell lines should show little transcriptional response; other GPCR-acting classes are the closest analogs, with prostanoid and other lipid-receptor agonists sharing downstream G-protein signaling.
